title: Cap. 7 Rat. 10 close: elect-only fruitful application by special decree via Christ’s merit
pass_a_gloss: This grace which is given on account of Christ to the elect alone, and which in them alone produces the effect of fruitful application and of salvation, flows to them not from some special operation of human choice, but from a special decree of the Divine will, and that by means of the merit of Christ. Therefore the merit of Christ was destined for the same persons in a certain special manner by God, applied by Christ himself.
pass_b_english: This grace, given for Christ's sake to the elect alone, and producing in them alone the fruitful application that saves, flows to them not from some special act of human choice but from a special decree of God's will, and that through Christ's merit. So Christ's merit was destined for those same persons in a special way by God, and applied by Christ himself.
source_text: Haec gratia quae datur propter Christum solis electis, quaeque in illis solis producit effectum fructuosae applicationis & salutis, non ex speciali aliqua operatione arbitrii humani, sed ex speciali decreto voluntatis Divinae ad eos dimanat, idque mediante merito Christi. Ergo Christi meritum fuit iisdem speciali quodam modo a Deo destinatum, ab ipso Christo applicatum.
